'''Gelly Farls''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Farls was married to [[Mambo Farls]], who worked designing corporate uniforms. She herself was a botanist and was employed by the company [[Biotherapy]] in their labs in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. She was also a member of the [[Bark Lovers' Alliance]], a local environmental group.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Mambo mentioned to Gelly that he was developing a new uniform for security staff at [[Culpharm]], a rival company of Biotherapy. She provided Biotherapy with a set of the uniforms, which she hoped they would use for illegal purposes, which the Bark Lovers' could then expose.
